name: bear-markdown-notes
description: Bear-style Markdown note-taking extension for Chrome & Firefox. Local-first, Obsidian-compatible.

scripts.dev:chrome: node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs chrome --manifest-only && vite build --mode development --watch --outDir ../dist-chrome --emptyOutDir=false
scripts.dev:firefox: node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs firefox --manifest-only && vite build --mode development --watch --outDir ../dist-firefox --emptyOutDir=false
scripts.build:chrome: npm run build && node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build && node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs firefox
scripts.build:all: npm run build && node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs chrome && node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs firefox && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
